## HueMux v0.0.4-alpha.14 — Icon-only tile buttons, narrow-phone columns, clean scene hover

> **Alpha.** Three visual fixes: the aggregate tiles' buttons are truly
> icon-only with larger glyphs, the grid drops to one column on narrow phones
> (the old boundary never fired on real 360px devices), and the scene chips
> no longer grey out their text area on hover.

### Tile buttons are icon-only

The favorite, color and power buttons on the aggregate tiles lose their
outline entirely — larger 26px glyphs, state carried by fill (soft on hover,
stronger when active), and the color button keeps its always-on tint.

### Narrow phones get one column

The one-column clamp now fires below 420px instead of 359px — a real 360px
phone stayed stuck on two columns because the old boundary never triggered.
Fixed 1–4 choices still give way to the clamp at that width.

### Scene chips hover clean

The text area of a preset chip no longer fills with a grey background on
hover — the saturation pop on the chip's border and background is the whole
effect now.
